system.description: Starting at 14th Level, your Flow, Voltaic state surges with consistent energy and efficiency. When you would enter the Voltaic state, by spending 2 Focus as part of entering the enhanced state, you begin Conduction. While in Conduction, you gain the benefits of Voltaic, you gain 1 rank of Shocked at the beginning of each of your turns and Speed Jolt is no longer once per turn. But while in Conduction, you instead take 1d12 lightning damage per rank of shocked, instead of 1d6.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
